A '''blaster rifle''' was a type of [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]]-shaped [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weaponry, typically with a longer [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] than other types of blasters.

==Description==
Blaster rifles were heavy-duty [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] variants, much more powerful than a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|pistol]], although heavy weapons were much more powerful than rifles.

Most rifles had a [[Stun/Legends|stun]] setting, used to temporarily disable an opponent.

Blaster rifles had a [[Stock/Legends|retractable stock]] and weighed about 4.5 kg for most models. The ideal range for the weapon was roughly 30&ndash;60+ meters. The typical blaster rifle had a value of 1,000 credits in the legal market; however, since a majority of systems outlawed the weapon for civilian use, black-market sales were prominent.

==Usage==
The rifle was usually a soldier's weapon of choice, and many variants were seen. It was the main weapon of regular infantry troops.<ref name="TRG1-" />

==History==
The blaster rifle was the staple infantry weapon since before the formation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and continued to be used hundreds of years after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], with no sign of being superseded. Substantial evidence pointed to the use of blaster technology by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], and their infantry forces may have wielded blasters in combat.
